counting_rule: One distinct root continuity defect is counted once. Repeated occurrences are affected_passages of the same repair. The earlier 115 audit entries, cosmetic edits, new prose and intentional literary questions receive no count in this incremental audit.
literary_mysteries: Uncertain storm history, material intent, the creature signals and later cultivation gates remain bounded open questions; no invented solution is counted.

validation.method: In-memory JavaScript comparison with the fixed review head. Counts use whitespace-delimited displayed text. This is not a claim that Python, Godot, audio or production quota validation ran.
